title: Python attribute-write #4 (type(x).m and type(self).m re-dispatch) and (a81) N8 diamond super — split out of GCLI-156 (DEC-303 a88/a84)
description: Split out of GCLI-156 before building under DEC-303 (a88) (split before building if needed, no ruling needed) because neither shape fits GCLI-156 two-round budget with shape #6. TWO ITEMS. (1) #4 from (a84) item 1: the type(x).m and type(self).m re-dispatch, which MOVED to GCLI-156 out of opum-ai/glyph-cli#236 and per (a84) item 1 gets its own two review rounds. tree-sitter mis-parses type(self).m = v as a PEP 695 type_alias_statement, so the write never reaches the binder. It must preserve dev class-body lazy re-scope (GCLI-144/146) and must NOT create the F1 class-body edge (class C: type(x).m = helper(); from lib import helper -> dev refuses, and the re-dispatch created app.py:helper). The (a83)/(a84) fixtures and their observed-red control travel with it. (2) N8 from (a81) item 2: super() resolved by B static MRO only if every in-repo descendant orders the class after B identically, else receiver/needs-inference; a coarser any-multi-base test is allowed; removal-only; runtime-MRO modelling is NOT taken. Dev wrong edge measured 2026-11-27 at origin/dev 1ea3432: D(B, C) with B.m = super().m() gives A.m where a D instance reaches C.m. Expected files src/python/calls.ts and test/python-hops.test.ts. No DEC-182 path class, no dependency.

acceptanceCriteria.text: #4 re-dispatches type(x).m and type(self).m as attribute writes without creating the F1 class-body edge and without changing dev class-body lazy re-scope (GCLI-144/146), with the (a83)/(a84) fixtures and an observed-red control

N8 resolves super() by the static MRO only when every in-repo descendant orders the class after B identically, else receiver/needs-inference, with both base orders and a diamond fixture, and a mutant per path observed red

Removal-only holds: the flag-extended subset check over the five pins, every fixture and the corpus shows no created and no flag-changed in-repo edge, group count stated with a floor equal to the exact count, an observed-red control and every removed edge named in the PR
No DEC-182 path class is touched and no dependency is added

implementationNotes: Scope addition from the leader relay of DEC-303 (a82) item 2: the (a82) non-enumerable alias blind spot rides this task as MEASURE-FIRST, not a build. Quote: an alias whose binding cannot be enumerated is named in the PR body as a blind spot and goes into GCLI-156 measurement; it is not built here. Measure occurrence on the five pins with a positive control (read-only, as (a81) item 3); build only if the measurement shows a reachable wrong edge and it fits two rounds, otherwise name it in the PR body as a documented blind spot.

WATCH ITEMS from #248 round 1 (N-f and the dev-equal holes N-a/N-b/N-c), to scope BEFORE building; not part of the #4/N8 build. N-f: the cls.__class__.m over-refusal (test/python-hops.test.ts, the test at ~:3083) was accepted by (a84) and was labelled "fix in GCLI-156"; it was neither fixed there nor carried, so it lands here. N-a: a write recorded on a MIXIN is invisible to the #6 guard (class C(B, Mix) where Mix writes self.m); a fix would walk each descendant own MRO as the class-attribute paths do. N-b: a class-body binding on a descendant (class C(B): m = 2) is neither a recorded write nor a def, so the guard does not see it. N-c: c = C(); c.m = 2 goes to addLocalAttrWrite, not classAttrWrites, so the guard does not see it. All three are dev-equal holes, not this PR; measure first if any is taken.

ROUND-2 NON-BLOCKING CARRIES from opum-ai/glyph-cli#248 (recorded after it landed at dev 4b29ee7; not pushed to #248). (a) Pin the N-d reason labels: the two N-d fixtures assert bins only, exactly as the kit compares bins and not reasons; add the unresolvedReceiverReasons assertion (needs-inference:1 on the written side, empty on the twin) the way the N1 fixture does. (b) The #6 comment at calls.ts says resolveModuleChain stays live "inside the wrapped read", but its call runs after the wrap returns, so the sentence is wording-only; correct it when the file is next touched. (c) N-e, round 1 lettering, unfixtured removal-only over-refusal: B().m(), x = B(); x.m(), B.m(o), h = B.m; h(), and f = B(); f() (__call__) never see a descendant instance and fall back to a name bin. List as a watch item; scope before building, do not add to the #4/N8 build silently.
